Commit\n95\t///\n96\t/// # Arguments\n97\t/// * `tx` - The transaction to use (must be an IMMEDIATE transaction)\n98\t/// * `worker` - The worker ID claiming the bead\n99\t/// * `claim_ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes after which in_progress beads are reclaimed\n100\t/// * `worker_metadata` - Optional worker metadata (model, harness, version)\n101\t///\n102\t/// # Returns\n103\t/// * `Ok(Some(claim_result))` - A bead was claimed\n104\t/// * `Ok(None)` - No beads available to claim\n105\t/// * `Err(e)` - Transaction error\n106\tpub fn claim(\n107\t    tx: &Connection,\n108\t    worker: &str,\n109\t    claim_ttl_minutes: i64,\n110\t    now: DateTime<Utc>,\n111\t    worker_metadata: Option<&WorkerMetadata>,\n112\t) -> Result<Option<ClaimResult>> {\n113\t\n114\t    // Step 0: Check migration_lock - return NONE if migration is in progress\n115\t    let lock_count: i64 = tx.query_row(\n116\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_lock WHERE expires_at > ?1\",\n117\t        params![now.to_rfc3339()],\n118\t        |row| row.get(0),\n119\t    ).unwrap_or(0);\n120\t    if lock_count > 0 {\n121\t        // Migration in progress - return None gracefully\n122\t        return Ok(None);\n123\t    }\n124\t\n125\t    // Step 1: Reclaim stale in_progress beads\n126\t    let stale_cutoff = now - Duration::minutes(claim_ttl_minutes);\n127\t    let reclaimed = tx.execute(\n128\t        \"UPDATE issues\n129\t         SET status = 'open', assignee = NULL, updated_at = ?\n130\t         WHERE status = 'in_progress'\n131\t           AND updated_at < ?\",\n132\t        params![now.to_rfc3339(), stale_cutoff.to_rfc3339()],\n133\t    )?;\n134\t\n135\t    // Step 2: Find candidate beads with impact scoring\n136\t    // Score = downstream_impact + critical_path_bonus\n137\t    // downstream_impact = count of beads blocked by this one\n138\t    // critical_path_bonus = 1000.0 / (float + 1) where float is from critical_path_cache\n139\t    // Zero-float beads get bonus = 1000, float-5 beads get ~167, non-critical beads get ~1\n140\t    // Velocity-aware scoring: prefer beads with lower expected duration\n141\t    // score = impact / expected_seconds (with fallback to standard scoring)\n142\t    let (model, harness) = if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n143\t        (meta.model.clone(), meta.harness.clone())\n144\t    } else {\n145\t        (None, None)\n146\t    };\n147\t\n148\t    // Velocity-aware claim: JOIN velocity_stats for requesting worker.\n149\t    // score = (impact * 3.0 + (4 - priority) * 2.0 + critical_path_bonus) / p50_seconds\n150\t    // Fallback p50_seconds = 1800 when no velocity data exists for this (model, harness, issue_type).\n151\t    if model.is_some() && harness.is_some() {\n152\t        let m = model.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n153\t        let h = harness.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n154\t\n155\t        let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n156\t            \"SELECT i.id\n157\t             FROM issues i\n158\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id\n159\t                 AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n160\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n161\t             LEFT JOIN velocity_stats vs ON vs.issue_type = i.issue_type\n162\t                 AND vs.model = ?1\n163\t                 AND vs.harness = ?2\n164\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n165\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n166\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n167\t               AND i.is_template = 0\n168\t               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n169\t               AND NOT EXISTS (\n170\t                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n171\t                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n172\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n173\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n174\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n175\t               )\n176\t             GROUP BY i.id\n177\t             ORDER BY (\n178\t                 COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) * 3.0\n179\t                 + (4 - i.priority) * 2.0\n180\t                 + 1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1)\n181\t             ) / COALESCE(vs.p50_seconds, 1800) DESC\n182\t             LIMIT 1\",\n183\t        )?;\n184\t\n185\t        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![m, h])?;\n186\t\n187\t        if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n188\t            let bead_id: String = row.get(0)?;\n189\t\n190\t            // Step 3: Update the winner to in_progress with a race condition check\n191\t            let rows_affected = tx.execute(\n192\t                \"UPDATE issues\n193\t                 SET status = 'in_progress', assignee = ?, updated_at = ?\n194\t                 WHERE id = ? AND status = 'open'\",\n195\t                params![worker, now.to_rfc3339(), &bead_id],\n196\t            )?;\n197\t\n198\t            if rows_affected == 0 {\n199\t                return Ok(None);\n200\t            }\n201\t\n202\t            // Step 4: Record worker session if metadata provided\n203\t            if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n204\t                tx.execute(\n205\t                    \"INSERT INTO worker_sessions (worker_id, model, harness, harness_version, bead_id, workspace_path)\n206\t                     VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)\",\n207\t                    params![\n208\t                        &meta.worker_id,\n209\t                        meta.model.as_deref(),\n210\t                        meta.harness.as_deref(),\n211\t                        meta.harness_version.as_deref(),\n212\t                        &bead_id,\n213\t                        \"\",\n214\t                    ],\n215\t                )?;\n216\t            }\n217\t\n218\t            // Step 5: Insert event with worker metadata in comment field\n219\t            let metadata_json = worker_metadata.and_then(|m| serde_json::to_string(m).ok());\n220\t            tx.execute(\n221\t                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, new_value, comment, created_at)\n222\t                 VALUES (?, 'claimed', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n223\t                params![&bead_id, worker, worker, metadata_json, now.to_rfc3339()],\n224\t            )?;\n225\t\n226\t            // Step 6: Mark as dirty\n227\t            tx.execute(\n228\t                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at)\n229\t                 VALUES (?, ?)\",\n230\t                params![&bead_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n231\t            )?;\n232\t\n233\t            return Ok(Some(ClaimResult {\n234\t                bead_id,\n235\t                reclaimed,\n236\t                workspace_path: None,\n237\t            }));\n238\t        }\n239\t\n240\t        Ok(None)\n241\t    } else {\n242\t        // Standard scoring without velocity data (original SQL-based scoring)\n243\t        let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n244\t            \"SELECT i.id, i.issue_type,\n245\t                    COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n246\t                    1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n247\t                    i.priority\n248\t             FROM issues i\n249\t             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n250\t             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n251\t             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n252\t               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n253\t               AND i.pinned = 0\n254\t               AND i.is_template = 0\n255\t               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n256\t               AND NOT EXISTS (\n257\t                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n258\t                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n259\t                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n260\t                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n261\t                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n262\t               )\n263\t             GROUP BY i.id\n264\t             ORDER BY\n265\t                 downstream_impact DESC,\n266\t                 critical_path_bonus DESC,\n267\t                 i.priority ASC,\n268\t                 i.created_at ASC\n269\t             LIMIT 1\",\n270\t        )?;\n271\t\n272\t        let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n273\t\n274\t        if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n275\t            let bead_id: String = row.get(0)?;\n276\t\n277\t            // Step 3: Update the winner to in_progress with a race condition check\n278\t            // The WHERE status = 'open' condition ensures we only claim if still open\n279\t            let rows_affected = tx.execute(\n280\t                \"UPDATE issues\n281\t                 SET status = 'in_progress', assignee = ?, updated_at = ?\n282\t                 WHERE id = ? AND status = 'open'\",\n283\t                params![worker, now.to_rfc3339(), &bead_id],\n284\t            )?;\n285\t\n286\t            // If no rows were affected, another worker claimed this bead first\n287\t            if rows_affected == 0 {\n288\t                return Ok(None);\n289\t            }\n290\t\n291\t            // Step 4: Record worker session if metadata provided\n292\t            if let Some(meta) = worker_metadata {\n293\t                tx.execute(\n294\t                    \"INSERT INTO worker_sessions (worker_id, model, harness, harness_version, bead_id, workspace_path)\n295\t                     VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)\",\n296\t                    params![\n297\t                        &meta.worker_id,\n298\t                        meta.model.as_deref(),\n299\t                        meta.harness.as_deref(),\n300\t                        meta.harness_version.as_deref(),\n301\t                        &bead_id,\n302\t                        \"\", // workspace_path not available in transaction context\n303\t                    ],\n304\t                )?;\n305\t            }\n306\t\n307\t            // Step 5: Insert event with worker metadata in comment field\n308\t            let metadata_json = worker_metadata.and_then(|m| serde_json::to_string(m).ok());\n309\t            tx.execute(\n310\t                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, new_value, comment, created_at)\n311\t                 VALUES (?, 'claimed', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n312\t                params![&bead_id, worker, worker, metadata_json, }\n331\t}\n332\t\n333\t/// Get ready candidates using the same scoring logic as claim().\n334\t///\n335\t/// This returns a list of beads that would be considered for claiming,\n336\t/// ordered by the same scoring formula:\n337\t/// - downstream_impact DESC (more blocking = higher priority)\n338\t/// - critical_path_bonus DESC (1000.0/(float+1), higher bonus = more critical)\n339\t/// - priority ASC (0=Critical, 4=Backlog)\n340\t/// - created_at ASC (FIFO tiebreaker)\n341\t///\n342\t/// # Arguments\n343\t/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n344\t/// * `limit` - Maximum number of candidates to return\n345\t///\n346\t/// # Returns\n347\t/// * `Ok(Vec<ScoredBead>)` - List of scored bead candidates\n348\tpub fn get_ready_candidates(tx: &Connection, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<ScoredBead>> {\n349\t    let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n350\t        \"SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.priority,\n351\t                COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n352\t                1000.0 / (COALESCE(c.float, 999) + 1) as critical_path_bonus,\n353\t                i.created_at\n354\t         FROM issues i\n355\t         LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n356\t         LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n357\t EXISTS (\n363\t               SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n364\t               INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n365\t               WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n366\t               AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n367\t               AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n368\t           )\n369\t         GROUP BY i.id\n370\t         ORDER BY\n371\t             downstream_impact DESC,\n372\t             critical_path_bonus DESC,\n373\t             i.priority ASC,\n374\t             i.created_at ASC\n375\t         LIMIT ?1\",\n376\t    )?;\n377\t\n378\t    let mut rows = stmt.query(params![limit as i64])?;\n379\t    let mut candidates = Vec::new();\n380\t\n381\t    while let }\n392\t\n393\t    Ok(candidates)\n394\t}\n395\t\n396\t/// Claim from the highest-priority bead across multiple workspaces.\n397\t///\n398\t/// Scores each workspace's top candidate, picks the global winner,\n399\t/// and claims from that workspace.\n400\t///\n401\t/// # Arguments\n402\t/// * `workspace_paths` - Slice of workspace directory paths\n403\t/// * `worker` - The worker ID claiming the bead\n404\t/// * `claim_ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes after which in_progress beads are reclaimed\n405\t/// * `worker_metadata` - Optional worker metadata (model, harness, version)\n406\t///\n407\t/// # Returns\n408\t/// * `Ok(Some(claim_result))` - A bead was claimed (with workspace_path set)\n409\t/// * `Ok(None)` - No beads available to claim in any workspace\n410\t/// * `Err(e)` - Transaction error\n411\tpub fn claim_any(\n412\t    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n413\t    worker: &str,\n414\t    claim_ttl_minutes: i64,\n415\t    worker_metadata: Option<&WorkerMetadata>,\n416\t) -> Result<Option<ClaimResult>> {\n417\t    use crate::config::load_metadata;\n418\t    use crate::storage::Storage;\n419\t\n420\t    // Score across all workspaces\n421\t    let mut best: Option<(Score, usize)> = None;\n422\t    for (idx, workspace_path) in workspace_paths.iter().enumerate() {\n423\t        let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n424\t        let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n425\t        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n426\t\n427\t        // Open each workspace's SQLite\n428\t        match Storage::open(&db_path) {\n429\t            Ok(storage) => {\n430\t                if let Some(score) = storage.top_candidate_score()? {\n431\t                    if best.as_ref().map(|(b, _)| score > *b).unwrap_or(true) {\n432\t                        best = Some((score, idx));\n433\t                    }\n434\t                }\n435\t            }\n436\t            Err(_) => {\n437\t                // Skip workspaces that can't be opened (e.g., no .beads directory)\n438\t                continue;\n439\t            }\n440\t        }\n441\t    }\n442\t\n443\t    match best {\n444\t        None => Ok(None),\n445\t        Some((_, workspace_idx)) => {\n446\t            let workspace_path = &workspace_paths[workspace_idx];\n447\t            let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n448\t            let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n449\t            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n450\t            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n451\t\n452\t            let now = Utc::now();\n453\t            match storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n454\t                claim(tx, worker, claim_ttl_minutes, now, worker_metadata)\n455\t            })? {\n456\t                Some(mut result) => {\n457\t                    result.workspace_path = Some(workspace_path.clone());\n458\t                    Ok(Some(result))\n459\t                }\n460\t                None => Ok(None),\n461\t            }\n462\t        }\n463\t    }\n464\t}\n465\t\n466\t/// Get the .beads directory from a workspace path.\n467\t///\n468\t/// If the workspace path itself contains a .beads directory, use it.\n469\t/// Otherwise, assume the path IS the .beads directory.\n470\tfn get_beads_dir(workspace_path: &Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf> {\n471\t    let beads_dir = workspace_path.join(\".beads\");\n472\t    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n473\t        Ok(beads_dir)\n474\t    } else if workspace_path.ends_with(\".beads\") {\n475\t        Ok(workspace_path.to_path_buf())\n476\t    } else {\n477\t        use anyhow::bail;\n478\t        bail!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace_path)\n479\t    }\n480\t}\n481\t\n482\t/// Find all bead workspace directories starting from a search path.\n483\t///\n484\t/// Searches for directories containing a .beads subdirectory.\n485\t/// Searches upward from the start path through parent directories.\n486\tpub fn find_workspaces(start_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {\n487\t\n488\t    let mut workspaces = Vec::new();\n489\t\n490\t    // Start from the given path and search upward\n491\t    let mut current = start_path.to_path_buf();\n492\t    loop {\n493\t        let beads_dir = current.join(\".beads\");\n494\t        if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n495\t            // Found a workspace - add the parent directory\n496\t            workspaces.push(current.clone());\n497\t        }\n498\t\n499\t        // Move to parent directory\n500\t        if !current.pop() {\n501\t            // Reached the root, stop searching\n502\t            break;\n503\t        }\n504\t    }\n505\t\n506\t    Ok(workspaces)\n507\t}\n508\t\n509\t#[cfg(test)]\n510\tmod tests {\n511\t    use Mitosis: split a parent bead into multiple child beads atomically.\n311\t///\n312\t/// This function constructs a batch of operations that:\n313\t/// 1. Creates N child beads\n314\t/// 2. Adds dependencies (child blocks parent) for each child\n315\t/// 3. Closes the parent bead\n316\t///\n317\t/// All operations run in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so there's no\n318\t/// risk of orphaned children if the process crashes midway.\n319\t///\n320\t/// # Arguments\n321\t/// * `parent_id` - The ID of the parent bead to split\n322\t/// * `children` - Vector of (title, type_, priority) tuples for each child\n323\t/// * `close_reason` - Reason for closing the parent (default: \"Split into children\")\n324\t///\n325\t/// # Returns\n326\t/// * `Ok(Vec<BatchOp>)` - Batch operations ready for execute_batch()\n327\t///\n328\t/// # Example\n329\t/// ```ignore\n330\t/// let ops = mitosis(\"bf-123\", vec![\n331\t///     (\"Child 1\".to_string(), \"task\".to_string(), 2),\n332\t///     (\"Child 2\".to_string(), \"bug\".to_string(), 0),\n333\t/// ], None)?;\n334\t/// let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, &workspace_dir)?;\n335\t/// ```\n336\tpub fn mitosis(\n337\t    parent_id: &str,\n338\t    children: Vec<(String, String, i32)>,\n339\t    close_reason: Option<String>,\n340\t) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n341\t    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n342\t\n343\t    // Create child beads\n344\t    for (title, type_, priority) in &children {\n345\t        ops.push(BatchOp::Create {\n346\t            title: title.clone(),\n347\t            type_: type_.clone(),\n348\t            priority: *priority,\n349\t            description: None,\n350\t            assignee: None,\n351\t            labels: Vec::new(),\n352\t        });\n353\t    }\n354\t\n355\t    // Add dependencies: each child blocks the parent\n356\t    // Reference children by placeholder (@0, @1, etc.)\n357\t    for (idx, _) in children.iter().enumerate() {\n358\t        ops.push(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n359\t            parent: format!(\"@{}\", idx),\n360\t            child: parent_id.to_string(),\n361\t        });\n362\t    }\n363\t\n364\t    // Close the parent\n365\t    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n366\t        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n367\t        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n368\t    });\n369\t\n370\t    Ok(ops)\n371\t}\n372\t\n373\t/// Option<String>,\n421\t    #[serde(default)]\n422\t    pub labels: Vec<String>,\n423\t}\n424\t\n425\tpub fn parse_stdin() -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n426\t    let mut input = String::new();\n427\t    std::io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input)?;\n428\t\n429\t    // Try JSON first\n430\t    if let Ok(ops) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BatchOp>>(&input) {\n431\t        return Ok(ops);\n432\t             title = Some(parts[i].clone());\n471\t                }\n472\t            }\n473\t            \"--type\" => {\n474\t                i += 1;\n475\t                if i < parts.len() {\n476\t                    type_ = parts[i].clone();\n477\t                }\n478\t            }\n479\t            \"--priority\" => {\n480\t                i += 1;\n481\t                if i < parts.len() {\n482\t                    priority = parts[i].parse().unwrap_or(2);\n483\t                }\n484\t            }\n485\t            \"--description\" => {\n486\t                i += 1;\n487\t                if i < parts.len() {\n488\t                    description = Some(parts[i].clone());\n489\t                }\n490\t            }\n491\t            _ => {\n492\t Closes the parent bead\n///\n/// All operations run in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so there's no\n/// risk of orphaned children if the process crashes midway.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `parent_id` - The ID of the parent bead to split\n/// * `children` - Vector of (title, type_, priority) tuples for each child\n/// * `close_reason` - Reason for closing the parent (default: \"Split ```\npub fn mitosis(\n    parent_id: &str,\n    children: Vec<(String, String, i32)>,\n    close_reason: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n\n    // Create
